name: Sol Joel Park play areas
text: Children's play areas in Sol Joel Park, with a skate park and parkour area. Leased to and run by Earley Town Council.

name: Meadow Park play areas
text: Two areas of play equipment and a swing area in Meadow Park, run by Earley Town Council.

name: Collins Drive play area
text: A play area opened in 2024 with a climbing frame and slide, swings, roundabout, seesaw and springer. Run by Earley Town Council.
